# ColorChord Living Spectrum
> Circle of fifths mapped to the color wheel. Live YIN resonance. Not a DAW.

- Play: https://play-colorchord.jonbailey.xyz/
- Landing: https://colorchord.jonbailey.xyz/
- Version: 2.2.0
- GitHub: https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/colorchord

## Quick answers
- What is ColorChord? A browser instrument: 12 fifths, 30 deg hue steps, C is crimson.
- Is it a DAW? No. It is a spectrum organ / chord-color toy.
- Pitch detect? YIN, voiced band 50-2000 Hz.
- CM7? Major seventh. Cm7 is minor seventh.
